svg.title: Appendix A2: attribution is an exploration, not a decision
svg.desc: Identity is declared, not discovered. Hubble could supply the who (which pod connected), CDC supplies the what (which change), and joining them is the open piece. Options are kept open and several claims are not verified.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: APPENDIX A2 · EXPLORATION, NOT A DECISION

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Attribution: who made the change?

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: THE PRINCIPLE

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Identity is declared, not discovered.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: An IP address is not an identity. Resolving it

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: after the fact is a bet against IP reuse.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Resolve it atomically, where the connection is made.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cilium Hubble already exposes pod identity per flow.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: THE TWO HALVES

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Who opened the connection?

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hubble (pod identity). Delegated, not built by us.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What changed in the data?

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CDC (txId, row content). Ours, measured.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How do the two join?

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: By time, or by txId via the server log (costly, one run). OPEN.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HONEST OUTCOMES · NEVER A SILENT GUESS

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: exact

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One candidate pod matches. We report it.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ambiguous

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Several match. We list them, never pick one.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: unknown_source

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No match. The change is still recorded.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A pooler is flagged, not blamed on the app. Not covered: DDL on PostgreSQL. Options stay open (Hubble, Cilium plugin, own sock_ops); porting Cilium's datapath is ruled out.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: NOT VERIFIED · do not present as fact

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: That Hubble flows let us ask which connections were open at time T, not only when one opened.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How pooled connections (for example PgBouncer) appear: identity may land on the pooler.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: That a time-window join is accurate enough for short-lived Jobs.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: That anyone needs per-change attribution at all. That is what we ask the community.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
